title: ActionRequest
description: An action an agent wants to take that its autonomy level does not allow alone. Posted to the Linear approval queue.

action.description: Exact change, specific enough to execute without interpretation

target.description: System and object, e.g. meta:adset:123 or shopify:product:handle

why.description: The gap or metric this addresses, with numbers

expected_effect.description: Metric, from, to, within how long

rollback.description: How to undo, and how fast

guardrail_check.description: Each relevant guardrail and why the action complies
